objectives.description: Implement string-split and one-element-array-split normalization rules
Guard against name-internal commas using shared heuristic
Dry-run diff output, summary count, idempotence

notes: Tested against a scratch copy of the live ~/Projects/Literature/index.json (270 entries), never against the live file itself: dry-run flagged exactly 122 entries (12 string-typed + 110 malformed one-element arrays), matching Phase 1's validate heuristic exactly. --apply on the scratch copy normalized all 122, left the already-correct 2-element ['Gabbay, Dov M.', 'Reynolds, Mark A.'] array untouched, preserved entry count (270) and IDs. A second dry-run against the normalized scratch copy reported zero changes (idempotent). Confirmed via md5sum and git status that the live ~/Projects/Literature/index.json and repo were never touched.
